pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Black Mirror
work.note: Black Mirror é uma série britânica criada por Charlie Brooker, estreada em 2011. A cena transforma a referência em prática linguística: “dois verbos do celular: take a photo (tirar foto) e make a call (fazer uma ligação)”. A referência mostra celulares e câmeras: take a photo, make a call.

facts.label: Combinar encontros
facts.sub: Convide com Are you free today? Sugira com Let us meet at + lugar. Pergunte What time? e responda At + hora. Diga o que leva com I bring + coisa.

facts.label: Mensagem primeiro
facts.sub: Nos EUA, para combinar com amigos, a maioria das pessoas manda mensagem. Isso evita ligar sem avisar e deixa a outra pessoa responder quando puder.

facts.label: Onde e quando
facts.sub: Um bom plano diz o lugar e a hora logo: “Let us meet at the park at five.” Se algo mudar, avise por mensagem, para ninguém esperar sem saber.

compare.us: In the USA, people often use short texts. “Let us meet at…” is a very common phrase.

pages.title: A text from Zoe · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Sunday in Chicago. Max is at home, and his phone buzzes. It is a message from his friend Zoe. The message is short and friendly. Max smiles and writes back fast. He loves plans with friends.
“Hi! Are you free today?” says Zoe. “Yes, I am. What is the plan?” says Max. “Let us meet at the park.” says Zoe.

pages.title: A text from Zoe · 3/3
paragraphs: “See you there, and send me a message later.” says Max. “Sure. See you soon!” says Zoe. Max puts a ball and a hat in his bag. At four thirty, he leaves the house. The park is green, and the sky is blue. Zoe waits near the big tree with a bottle of water. They play, laugh and drink water until the sun goes down. A simple text makes a good afternoon.
